definitions.supplemental: Bryt a Briton, ford a ford

quotations.old_english: Tostig wæs ðá æt Brytforda [MS. Brytfordan] mid ðam cinge [MS. kinge]
quotations.english: Tostig was then at Britfqrd with the king

source_text: Bryt-ford, es; m. [Bryt a Briton, ford a ford] BRITFORD, near Sarum, Wiltshire :-- Tostig wæs ðá æt Brytforda [MS. Brytfordan] mid ðam cinge [MS. kinge] Tostig was then at Britfqrd with the king, Chr. 1065; Erl. 194, 38.
